argv:
echo "-- pin-disposition history: commit and file sha"; for c in $(git log --format=%H -- tools/pin-disposition.py); do printf "%s %s\n" "$c" "$(git show $c:tools/pin-disposition.py | sha256sum | cut -c1-64)"; done
echo "-- find runner object matching historical manifest sha"; for c in $(git log --format=%H -- tools/mutate-and-run.sh); do s=$(git show $c:tools/mutate-and-run.sh | sha256sum | cut -c1-64); if [ "$s" = 75ed934dc86360f5c2cdd5b17abb8814249425e9c1835d36b81d74412719adc5 ]; then printf "%s %s\n" "$c" "$s"; break; fi; done
echo "-- final runner sha"; sha256sum tools/mutate-and-run.sh
echo "-- final source sha"; sha256sum corpus/SOURCES.md
